discussion.body:
Act 0 screenplay + director commentary. Design only. No status change. HEAD not moved. No new ids. No source.
Local copy: artifacts/asteria-cast/storyline/act-00-screenplay.md Targets FEAT-013 (module) with FEAT-052 scenes inside. Locks from 013720Z board as corrected by 014240Z (two mains + Halric/Rook cameos).
LOCKS Playable: Cael Ward from wake, Liraen Quill from The Low Tide. Both plot armor. Cameo only: Halric Bent (custom house), Rook Fenn (quay). Off this act: Brann, Seris, Nym, Ash, Ysolde, Maera. No Vortan, Velith, Nyxara by name. WillowDale = Northern Breskshire. Padon = own region northeast of WillowDale. Cannon aims vertical/spaceward; tick only. 2.5D plates+sprites. ATB Attack/Wait. Working boss label Act 0 Boss. No proper name. No temple. No death flag. Mist cannot be cleared. Boss does not respawn after act00_boss_down. Act 7 is not this ending.
S0 WAKE — EXT PADON SHED, MORNING No logo. Cael already in the door. NARRATOR: A tool-shed on the south ruts. Morning. / Harvest ticket: WillowDale ferry. Before dusk. / Gate paper, unsigned. Blade unmarked. DIR: Hold black half a second, then Cael standing. Teach walk and Z on the ruts exit. No wake-up stretch. No north sky yet.
S1 HARVEST — EXT PADON HARVEST, DAY OREN (pass): Keep your boots off the next sheaf. OREN: North sky ticked before dawn. Thunder out of season. CAEL: I heard it from the shed. OREN: Then you heard it late. Grain still goes south. You still go with it. CHOICE: The tick. / The Gate paper. / I'll move. Tick branch — CAEL: That was not weather. OREN: I called it thunder so the row would keep moving. Do not put a sky on my ledger. WillowDale stamps. Constium ticks. Padon cuts. That is the whole politics of a scythe. Paper branch — CAEL: The paper is still unsigned. OREN: I cannot sign Gate steel. Nessa cannot. Halric can, and he is not in this field. Finish the ticket. Then you can be a problem on somebody else's porch. Move branch — OREN: South road. Before dusk. Bram already ran it twice. After ~8s on plate, if unset: NARRATOR: A vertical white tick on the north horizon. Stone on stone. Not weather. RHETT interrupt if in radius: There. North. Tell my brother I am still working. / CAEL: He already named it thunder. / RHETT: He named it so the wagons would not stop. I am not a wagon. Optional shed — NESSA: Unsigned Gate paper is still on the nail. CAEL: Oren will not sign it. NESSA: Neither will I. Shed-kin is not Gate-kin. CHOICE: Keep it on the nail. / I have it. Flavor only; does not recruit Halric. Optional shrine — NARRATOR: Three fieldstones. A dried Root token. The token is dry. No blessing. DIR: Tick is one white frame plus dry stone-on-stone. Camera does not fly to Constium. Oren does not turn to camera. Shrine does not heal.
S2 SOUTH ROAD — EXT, DAY JOSS: Road's chewed. Carts take the left rut. Something was in the copse this morning. Not a hog worth naming. Fight: grain-hog vermin. Cael solo. Attack/Wait. Plot armor. NARRATOR: Field vermin. Not the wrong weather. Not yet. GATE RIDER pass-by: Dust. Not a greeting. Courtesy road is north. I am not your clerk. DIR: One fight. Milestone camera mid-plate: WillowDale roofs + channel silver. Rider is not a cutscene.
S3 WILLOWDALE — first enter NARRATOR: WillowDale. Northern Breskshire. A few hundred souls and one day-ferry. The channel cuts toward Meddos. King's Sea sits past that.
S3 LOW TIDE — Liraen join (inn hotspot if unset) NARRATOR: A travel coat over performance cloth. Bow, short blade. LIRAEN: The innkeep's mist story does not scan as weather. Neither does the north tick. CAEL: Padon called it thunder out of season. LIRAEN: Padon has a scythe. Iunum has songs. Neither covers a sky that cracks on a clock. CHOICE: Walk the tick. / Walk the mist. / I have a ticket to stamp. Tick: Then we are already late. Constium does not wait on a ferry. Mist: Standing mist on a clear night is a border, not a cloud. I want the border. Ticket: Stamp it. I will still be on the porch. NARRATOR: She does not ask to join. She is already standing when you leave. DIR: No meet-cute. No song. Moth street interrupt may fire first (Singer's already in the common). Songs are not a second command menu. Edda after join, dusk unset: Mist on the inland road last week. Clear night. That is not weather. / CAEL: The custom house will not stamp that. / EDDA: Cill stamps grain. I rent bunks. Pick which desk you trust. CHOICE Take the bunk / Ask about the singer / The ferry — all three set dusk. No boat launches.
S3 CUSTOM HOUSE — Halric cameo NARRATOR: Breskshire stag-mark. A levy board. Iron's Gate is conscripting for a dwarven courtesy. HALRIC: Ward. You still look like harvest. CAEL: The paper is unsigned. HALRIC: Courtesy means an escort to Constium. Sky-work. Not orcs. I am not taking you tonight. CHOICE: What is sky-work? / Why not tonight? / The grain first. Sky: Vertical. Spaceward. The thing that ticked this morning is not a storm and it is not my story to finish in a custom house. LIRAEN if joined: A clock in the north sky is already a story. HALRIC: Finish the grain. Then the Gate road. Tonight: Because Brune will not put a boat under Gate steel after dark, and I am not walking you inland through standing mist with unsigned paper. That is courtesy. It is also sense. Grain: Good. Hodge wants a count. I want you off my floor. HODGE interrupt: If Bent is still on my floor, the count waits. Steel first. Sacks second. CILL: Levy board is current. Courtesy column is new ink. I stamp grain. I do not stamp mist. Take weather to the inn. DIR: Halric does not fight, does not walk to the quay, does not travel after dusk. No one says World Cannon.
S3 WAREHOUSE NARRATOR: Sheaves, loft, a cat that owns the doorway. Stall: one tonic, already on your tab if you stamp the ticket. DIR: First buy. One item. Not a dungeon.
S3 QUAY — Rook cameo BRUNE: Stamped grain to Meddos. Daylight only. CAEL: I heard Iron's Gate is conscripting. BRUNE: Heard it too. I still have one sun and one boat. CHOICE: Take the grain. / A night crossing. Grain: Ticket on the board. Maeve takes copper. Kit coils. NARRATOR: Rook Fenn leans the far piling. Knives under a travel cloak. ROOK: Meddos woods are breathing white. I am not selling you a crossing. Just the rumor. Night: BRUNE: No. I am not putting a boat under a Gate rider at night. Ask Kit if you want a bad idea. Do not ask me. ROOK: Night would not improve them. Return prompt if saw_ferry unset-Rook: You look like a ticket with legs. / CAEL: Meddos? / ROOK: Woods inland of the landing went white. LIRAEN if joined: White like standing mist, or white like a lie? / ROOK: Like breath that does not leave. Dusk quay: BRUNE: Not after dark. / CAEL: The ticket is stamped. / BRUNE: The sun is not. Inland road or a bunk. Not my plank. KIT interrupt: Let me take it. One night crossing. He will shout after. No: Then coil your own rope. Yes: BRUNE: Kit. KIT: ...coil my own rope. BRUNE: Inland. Both of you. DIR: No night boat. Rook does not board. Kit exists so the lock is argued.
S4 CAMP — EXT INLAND ROAD, NIGHT NARRATOR: The ferry is shut. The south road is done. Stars are clean. Then standing mist walks in from the west. No river. No breath-cloud. LIRAEN: Do not name it yet. Names make people stamp. CAEL: Cill already refused. LIRAEN: Good. Then it is still a road and not a column. Veil-beasts, two short waves. Holes with animal weight. Two-person ATB. NARRATOR: The holes close. The mist comes back around your feet. It cannot be cleared. Liraen looks once. She does not name it. DIR: Shared look allowed. Not a romance scene. No clear-sky reward.
S5 FEAT-052 — EXT FIELD EAST OF THE RUTS Working label Act 0 Boss. Short squat turtle-like body, huge bald blue-gray head, inflamed red-rimmed wet eyes, wide irregular toothy mouth, olive plastron, dark back shell, spiral tail. Mist given a shell. Do not name it. Two-person ATB. Optional Tam tonic. Win: The shell slumps wet into the furrows. Mist thins to ground-fog. It does not stand up again. DIR: act00_boss_down. No respawn. No named loot. Title card on this plate.
S6 TITLE AND GATE — EXT HARVEST ROAD, FIRST LIGHT TITLE: ASTERIA NARRATOR: First light on the harvest road. North edge: Gate dust. The courtesy is real. Act 1 is not loaded. Leave plate: Act 0 holds. Padon to WillowDale is walked. Two figures on the road. The Gate dust is waiting. The save will reopen east of the ruts. DIR: Both figures allowed on the card. Continue reopens east of the ruts. Do not load Act 1. Gate dust is a prop.
CLOCK 00:00-00:45 S0 / 00:45-07:00 S1 / 07:00-12:00 S2 / 12:00-20:00 S3 (steal linger here) / 20:00-23:30 S4 / 23:30-28:00 S5 / 28:00-30:00 S6
BIBLE Camera: no fly-to-Cannon, no town crane. Sound: tick is stone not thunder. Plants three unanswered things (vertical tick, standing mist, courtesy not about orcs). Off-limits: World Cannon, villain names, Maze Fissure, Act 7, romance, any recruit but Liraen. Story weight on Oren, Nessa, Edda, Cill, Hodge, Brune, Kit, Tam, plus two cameos.
Impl note: this chat does not patch Stackocakes-Hub/Asteria. Workspace harness already plays this board.
